name: tinker-cleaner
description: System Junk Cleaner Plugin for TINKER

tinker.name: Cleaner
tinker.description: Scan and clean system junk files to free disk space

zh-CN.name: 垃圾清理
zh-CN.description: 扫描和清理系统垃圾文件，释放磁盘空间

scan.description: Scan system junk locations and update the plugin UI. Returns items with non-zero size. Call this before clean.

get.description: Get the current scan results without rescanning. If a scan is in progress, waits for it to finish.

clean.description: Clean selected junk items by id. Call scan first to discover ids. Skips the UI confirm dialog. Optionally rescans afterward and returns updated results.

ids.description: Rule ids to clean from the scan results

moveToTrash.description: Move files to trash instead of deleting permanently. Defaults to the current UI setting.
